title: Design: the date list, the custom range and its two messages
refs: SV-11718 (Reports Story 3 S3-R1 Reports Story 1 S1-N1)
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access'.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Open the Date filter.
  3. Pick Custom range.
  4. Type 01/01/2025 in From and 10/31/2026 in To.
  5. Type 01/01/2027 in From and 01/31/2027 in To.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens with "Date: This month" in blue.

Step 2:

  • The list reads This month (ticked), Last month, This quarter, Last 90 days, Year to date and Custom range.

Step 3:

  • From and To date boxes show under Custom range, as in picture 20.11.

Step 4:

  • Red text under the boxes reads "Choose a date range of one year or less."

Step 5:

  • Gray help text reads "One year at most." and the chip reads "Date: Jan 1 – Jan 31, 2027".
  • The table shows a calendar icon over "There are no results for selected date range".
